description:
This spacious high-spec top floor two-bedroom flat is offered for sale in very good condition, ideally suited to buyers seeking a very well-presented property in a secluded location in central Reading.

The property features an open-plan kitchen living room with good natural light and integrated appliances, creating a practical space for cooking,dining and relaxing. The master bedroom includes built-in wardrobes and an en-suite shower room, while the second bedroom is a comfortable double also with built in wardrobes. There is a further bathroom, providing flexibility for guests. The flat also benefits from allocated parking, a valuable asset in this sought-after location. The property has an EPC rating of C and falls within Council Tax Band D. Viewing are highly recommended to appreciate all the property has to offer.

Situated in Reading town centre, the flat is well placed for a wide range of local amenities. The nearby high street offers shops, supermarkets, cafés and restaurants, while the Oracle shopping centre is within easy reach. Local green spaces such as Forbury Gardens provide pleasant areas for walking and relaxation.

Public transport links are a key feature of this location. Reading Station is accessible from the property and provides frequent services to London Paddington, typically in around 25 minutes on fast services, as well as routes to Oxford, Newbury and other Thames Valley destinations. Local bus services operate along nearby routes, connecting to surrounding neighbourhoods and business parks.

Overall, this two-bedroom flat for sale offers a practical layout and convenient access to Reading’s commercial, leisure and transport facilities.

Details supplied by vendor -

Lease 125 years from 2014 

Service charge £1704pa

Ground rent £375pa

 EPC rating: C. Tenure: Leasehold,
